x: Bronze in the 100m (10.07w), winner of the 200m in a legal 20.11, silver medal with Marcus in the 4x100 in a new UK record of 37.98, and another gold in the 4x400 with John running an incredible 43.93 split as the quartet sped to a new European record of 2:58.22
Fine wins were recorded by Marcus(200m) and Nigel (Javelin) and by the 4x100 realy team (Lenny,Dave,John,Phil), who showed all the other teams how to run a relay.
The 4x400 also ended in excitement with Nigel from Blackheath and Jay fighting out the last leg. This followed a cool 47.5 from Marcus. Blackheath won the Meeting and the relay.
Marcus was knackered and rumour had it that Lennie Paul had run the previous night with a broken toe! Well, as it turned out, all of this was true.

One person we knew would not make it was Marcus who had terminated an 'iffy' season with hamstring and knee injuries. Phil Goedluck too was out, waiting for an operation on his knee, and so it was a pleasant surprise to see John Regis on the day as we didn't have much cover.
